meta.scope: Additional job boards, remote feeds, ATS career-site engines, regional sources, and tracker-adjacent products.
meta.verification_policy: Official_listing_api is true only where the source itself or a clearly documented public endpoint was found. Secondary endpoint references are marked in notes and should be rechecked before production use.

famous_platforms.why: This batch prioritizes additional options rather than rechecking every famous platform.

ats_engines.why: Several underdog ATS products still need individual primary-documentation verification.

boards_aggregators_niches.why: Regional, visa, language-specific, government, and university sources remain incomplete.

direct_company_sources.why: Company tokens and board URLs need a separate verification pass.

ai_job_automation.why: The present batch emphasizes listing sources and ATS engines.

sources.name: Remote OK
sources.cost_notes: Public job feeds are available without a paid account. Employer promotion and other commercial products may be separate.

data_access.notes: Public feeds: https://remoteok.com/api and https://remoteok.com/remote-jobs.rss. The feed is broad and may include sponsored or stale listings.

geo.priority_reason: A free JSON and RSS feed makes it practical for broad remote discovery, although country eligibility needs manual verification.

sources.tracking_fit: Good for ingestion because listing URLs and feed records are available; retain a description hash because source IDs may not be permanent.

sources.name: Remote OK RSS
sources.cost_notes: Public RSS feed with no card requirement.

geo.priority_reason: RSS is simple and free to poll, but descriptions and eligibility metadata may be incomplete.

sources.tracking_fit: Useful as a lightweight discovery feed; use canonical URL plus normalized title-company-location identity.

sources.name: Himalayas
sources.cost_notes: The public API and RSS feed are described as free and unauthenticated.

data_access.notes: Public API: https://himalayas.app/jobs/api. RSS: https://himalayas.app/jobs/rss. Search and filtering by keyword, country, timezone, and seniority are described on the API page.

geo.priority_reason: Country and timezone filters are especially useful for ranking opportunities for a Pakistan-based remote applicant.

sources.tracking_fit: Excellent for a free MVP if the API supplies a stable listing URL or ID; preserve the feed ID and a content hash.

sources.name: Himalayas Jobs API
sources.cost_notes: Public JSON API described as free and requiring no API key.

data_access.notes: Endpoint: https://himalayas.app/jobs/api. The API page describes pagination and keyword, country, timezone, seniority, and employment-type filtering.

geo.priority_reason: It provides one of the clearest free remote-job APIs for region-aware discovery.

sources.tracking_fit: Strong if the API returns a stable job identifier; otherwise use URL and content fingerprint.

sources.name: We Work Remotely
sources.cost_notes: Public job browsing and RSS discovery are free; employer postings are commercial.

data_access.notes: Public RSS feed: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss. No official JSON listing API was verified.

geo.priority_reason: Its RSS feed is free and remote-focused, though many roles restrict hiring to particular countries.

sources.tracking_fit: Good discovery source; store the feed GUID if present and fall back to canonical URL.

sources.name: Remotive
sources.cost_notes: A public remote-jobs API is available for discovery; employer services may be paid.

data_access.notes: Public API pattern: https://remotive.com/api/remote-jobs. Search and limit parameters are described in public API references; verify current official terms before polling at scale.

geo.priority_reason: Remote-focused structured listings and search parameters make it practical for a free discovery pipeline.

sources.tracking_fit: Good if listing IDs and publication dates are retained; cross-posting with company ATS pages is likely.

sources.name: Recruitee
sources.cost_notes: Public career-page listings may be available without a job-seeker account; employer API access and account features are separate.

data_access.notes: Official API documentation exists, but the Careers Site API requires an employer-generated API token. A commonly available public career-page pattern is https://{company}.recruitee.com/api/offers/; verify whether the specific employer exposes it publicly.

geo.priority_reason: The platform is useful for company watchlists, but the official Careers Site API may require employer credentials.

sources.tracking_fit: Good when the public offer record includes a stable offer ID; otherwise store the career URL and content hash.

sources.name: Teamtailor
sources.cost_notes: Public career pages may be viewed without payment; the official API is generally intended for customer integrations.

data_access.notes: Official API documentation describes listing jobs, departments, locations, and job URLs. API hosts include https://api.teamtailor.com and https://api.na.teamtailor.com. A public XML feed may be enabled by the employer; do not assume every company has one.

geo.priority_reason: It can be valuable for targeted company watchlists, but public access varies by employer configuration.

sources.tracking_fit: Good if the Teamtailor job ID and employer career-domain URL are saved.

sources.name: Workable
sources.cost_notes: Public career pages can expose published jobs without a job-seeker subscription; employer features are paid.

data_access.notes: Common public career feed pattern: https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{account}. Verify the current official public-widget documentation and account-specific availability.

geo.priority_reason: Public account-level feeds can make company monitoring feasible, though discovery still requires a company list.

sources.tracking_fit: Useful when the Workable shortcode and job shortcode are preserved; canonical apply URLs are generally clear.

sources.name: Personio
sources.cost_notes: Some public employer career pages expose an XML job feed; Personio employer software is commercial.

data_access.notes: Common public XML pattern: https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language=en. Treat this as a career-page feed pattern unless Personio’s current official documentation confirms universal availability.

geo.priority_reason: Personio is common among European employers, where relocation and work-permit information can be more explicit.

sources.tracking_fit: Moderate; XML feeds can provide stable URLs but may lack a universal stable ID.

sources.name: BambooHR Career Pages
sources.cost_notes: Public job pages may be browsed without payment; employer ATS features are commercial.

data_access.notes: Common career-page pattern: https://{company}.bamboohr.com/careers/list. A JSON response is frequently observed, but a universal official unauthenticated listing API was not verified.

geo.priority_reason: It is useful for company-level monitoring, but public feed behavior and metadata differ by employer.

sources.tracking_fit: Moderate; save the employer subdomain and job URL because stable IDs are not guaranteed.

sources.name: JazzHR
sources.cost_notes: Employer software is commercial; public job-board pages may be viewable without a job-seeker account.

data_access.notes: Public board behavior varies by employer. No universal unauthenticated listing API was verified in this pass.

geo.priority_reason: It is worth supporting through pasted career URLs but does not yet justify a first-wave polling connector.

sources.tracking_fit: Paste-url support is adequate; stable IDs and public feed behavior need employer-specific validation.

sources.name: Breezy HR
sources.cost_notes: Employer product has paid plans and possibly a limited free tier; job-seeker access to public postings is normally free.

data_access.notes: Public career-page feeds are reported by integration references, but no official universal endpoint was independently verified here.

geo.priority_reason: Support public career URLs, but defer polling until a current public-feed contract is confirmed.

sources.tracking_fit: Reasonable for pasted URLs; stable identifiers vary by employer career page.

sources.name: Workable Public Career Pages
sources.cost_notes: Public pages are free to view; employer software is paid.

data_access.notes: Public widget pattern commonly uses https://apply.workable.com/api/v1/widget/accounts/{account}. Treat account-specific availability as variable.

geo.priority_reason: It provides structured company-level data without requiring a paid job-seeker account.

sources.tracking_fit: Good when company and job shortcodes are retained; use the public apply URL as the canonical human destination.

sources.name: Personio XML Career Feed
sources.cost_notes: Employer career feed is public where enabled; no user subscription is required to read it.

data_access.notes: Common XML pattern: https://{company}.jobs.personio.de/xml?language=en. Marked unverified as a universal official feed.

geo.priority_reason: European employer coverage can make relocation and work-permit language more discoverable.

sources.tracking_fit: Moderate; use XML job URL plus title-company-location hash because a stable ID may be absent.

sources.name: Recruitee Public Offers Feed
sources.cost_notes: Public employer offers can be viewed without a job-seeker subscription; authenticated Careers API access is employer-controlled.

data_access.notes: Common public pattern: https://{company}.recruitee.com/api/offers/. The official API documentation states the Careers Site API requires authentication, so do not treat every public pattern as guaranteed.

geo.priority_reason: Useful for targeted startup and European-company monitoring when a public offers endpoint is available.

sources.tracking_fit: Good enough for an adapter with fallback identity matching; exact stable-ID behavior needs testing.

sources.name: Teamtailor Public Career Pages
sources.cost_notes: Public pages are free to browse; employer API access is controlled by the customer account.

data_access.notes: Official API documentation covers jobs and job URLs. API hosts include api.teamtailor.com and api.na.teamtailor.com. Public XML feed availability depends on employer configuration.

geo.priority_reason: A useful underdog ATS for company watchlists, particularly when an employer exposes structured career data.

sources.tracking_fit: Good if the Teamtailor job ID and company career domain are retained.

sources.name: Remote Job RSS Aggregator Pattern
sources.cost_notes: The underlying feeds are public; do not assume all third-party normalization services are free.

data_access.notes: This is a research reference, not an owned job source. It documents Remote OK JSON, Remotive JSON, We Work Remotely RSS, and Himalayas API.

geo.priority_reason: It is useful for designing adapters but should not replace direct use of the individual feeds.

sources.tracking_fit: Useful as a schema reference only; the individual source should be stored as the actual source.

sources.name: JOBO ATS Provider Reference
sources.cost_notes: This is an integration/reference product rather than a primary job board. Pricing and terms were not verified.

data_access.notes: Documentation lists integrations including BambooHR, Personio, JazzHR, Recruitee, Teamtailor, Rippling, Breezy HR, and Homerun. It is not itself a source for the personal pipeline.

geo.priority_reason: It may help understand ATS coverage but does not provide a clearly free, primary listing feed for the MVP.

sources.tracking_fit: Useful for ecosystem mapping, not as a canonical source.

new_observations: Remote OK, Remotive, We Work Remotely, and Himalayas can all carry overlapping remote roles.
ATS feeds are usually closer to the employer source than aggregator records.
A role found through an aggregator should be linked to an ATS record when company, title, location, and description substantially match.

dedupe_key.secondary: source plus stable job ID plus company slug
dedupe_key.fallback: normalized title plus company plus location plus description fingerprint

ranked_discovery_tactics: Remote OK, Remotive, We Work Remotely, and similar worldwide-remote feeds
Employer ATS searches containing remote worldwide, EOR, contractor, and Pakistan
EU relocation and Blue Card searches
Canada and Australia work-permit or sponsorship searches
scoring_signals: Pakistan explicitly listed as an eligible country
pakistan_relocation_remote.honest_caveat: Remote boards contain many jobs that are remote only within a specified country or region. A lower score is more honest than exclusion because eligibility language can be incomplete or outdated.

direct_company_playbook.verification_note: Do not infer a company slug from a search snippet alone. Verify the employer career page and preserve the exact public URL.

ai_saas_landscape.name: Teal
ai_saas_landscape.our_model_difference: We retain control of discovery, material preparation, and human submission.

ai_saas_landscape.name: Huntr
ai_saas_landscape.our_model_difference: We use source feeds and a custom pipeline rather than relying on a closed tracker.

ai_saas_landscape.name: Simplify
ai_saas_landscape.our_model_difference: We do not automate submission and can use it only as an optional human-controlled downstream tool.

ai_saas_landscape.name: LazyApply
ai_saas_landscape.our_model_difference: Our model deliberately avoids unattended mass submission.

ai_saas_landscape.name: LoopCV
ai_saas_landscape.our_model_difference: Our source-of-truth is the employer or board listing, with a human deciding whether to apply.

ai_saas_landscape.name: Jobscan
ai_saas_landscape.our_model_difference: It may be used after ingestion to improve materials, but it is not a source or tracker.

ignore_initially: Authenticated ATS APIs requiring employer credentials
Feeds with no stable URL, ID, or meaningful description
recommended_mvp.free_definition: Count a source as free only when a user can access listing data without a paid plan or card. Employer-paid ATS software does not make its public career listings paid for the applicant.
